simple.meaning: פָּארוּר (pâʼrûwr) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, illuminated , i.e. a glow ; as noun, a flush (of anxiety).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פָּארוּר (H6289) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joel 2:6, with occurrences in Joel, Nahum.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּארוּר (H6289) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פָּארוּר (H6289) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פָּארוּר (pâʼrûwr) / H6289 is traced through Joel 2:6, Nahum 2:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
